CommunityApplications.Profile: Official Unraid templates from the Maintainerr team. Maintainerr is a library maintenance tool for Plex, Jellyfin and Emby: build custom rules across your media stack (Radarr, Sonarr, Seerr, Tautulli and more), surface matching media in a collection for a configurable number of days, and automatically handle the cleanup. For help, open an issue on GitHub or join our Discord.
